description: Header file defining the MigrationPreparerImplementation class, which implements the IMigrationPreparer interface for managing migration data store, component readiness, and reset functionalities within the RDK framework.

classes.name: MigrationPreparerImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IMigrationPreparer interface, providing methods for managing migration data, component readiness, and reset operations within the RDK framework.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to the migration data store.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an entry from the migration data store by key.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a value from the data store given a key.

methods.name: setComponentReadiness
methods.description: Sets the readiness status for a specified component.

methods.name: getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components and their readiness statuses.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Performs a reset operation based on the specified reset type.
